subject.title: Review each selected PR in its own item shard

question: Should this production queue-protocol and workflow-topology change advance from draft after the specified isolated canary and two-item validation, or should it be narrowed before rollout?
rationale: The remaining question is operational acceptance of a new cancellation and mutation-serialization model; source review and unit coverage cannot establish its behavior against live GitHub Actions dispatches and Durable Object lease timing.

options.title: Require the planned isolated canary
options.body: Keep the PR draft until the two-item validation records same-item cancellation, unaffected sibling work, stale-publication rejection, and terminal reconciliation.

options.title: Narrow the rollout
options.body: Split the production topology change from the protocol-v3 and durable-comment refresh work so each live behavior can be admitted independently.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Defer the item-sharded execution model if its operational benefit does not justify the added queue and workflow complexity.

recommendation.title: Require the planned isolated canary
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft until the two-item validation records same-item cancellation, unaffected sibling work, stale-publication rejection, and terminal reconciliation.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the supplied queue-protocol and item-sharding commit sequence and is best positioned to provide the requested canary evidence.
